examples.text: Viele kinderlose Frauen sprechen öffentlich über ihre Sehnsucht nach einer Familie. Der Therapeut Matthias Stiehler weiß, wie es kinderlosen Männern gehen kann. Und was ihnen bei der Sinnfrage hilft.
examples.translation: Many childless women speak publicly about their longing for a family. Therapist Matthias Stiehler knows what the experiences of childless men can be like. And what helps them find purpose.
examples.english: Many childless women speak publicly about their longing for a family. Therapist Matthias Stiehler knows what the experiences of childless men can be like. And what helps them find purpose.
